verdict.rationale: Community-reported Geekbench results from a leaked iPad unboxing show M5 single-core at 4133 vs about 3679–3748 for M4. That is a 10–12% gain at the same max clock, attributed to IPC and a larger L2 cache, so the gain is real rather than a GHz bump. However, the evidence only compares M5 to its predecessor. It does not establish 'leading' single-thread performance against competing chips, and the 'instant' interactive feel is unevidenced. missing for 10: head-to-head single-thread comparisons against competitor CPUs, formal independent review benchmarks (beyond a leaked unbox video), first-party single-thread performance documentation, and hands-on evidence of interactive responsiveness.
